answer: In a simple logistic regression model assessing age and camrelizumab treatment response (where response is coded as 1 for responders [PR / Group 1] and 0 for non-responders [SD/PD / Group 2]), the coefficient estimate (change in log-odds) for age is approximately -0.0750 (exact: -0.07495, standard error: 0.0244, z = -3.078, p = 0.0021, 95% CI: [-0.1227, -0.0272], corresponding to an odds ratio of 0.9278 per additional year of age).
